title: hcp-manager embedding configuration v1
description: <workspace>/embedding.yaml: which provider turns the text of a block into a vector, and which store keeps the vectors. Without the file the local `hashing` provider and the SQLite store are used. Either one provider written flat (the profile is then called `default`), or several named `profiles` with one `active_profile`. A remote provider receives nothing unless `allow_remote` is true, the command is run with --authorize-remote, and the document says `embed_remote: true` in the inventory; an endpoint on localhost is local. API keys are never written here: only the name of an environment variable (`api_key_env`) or an external command that prints the key (`api_key_command`).

command.description: program and arguments, no shell; reads {"texts": [...]} on stdin, writes {"model", "version", "dim", "vectors"} on stdout

base_url.description: provider openai: the service address, with or without /v1 (https://host, https://host/v1); the request goes to <base_url>/embeddings after the version prefix is normalised

embeddings_path.description: provider openai: the path of the embeddings endpoint when it is neither /v1/embeddings nor <base_url>/embeddings (for example /api/paas/v4/embeddings); appended to the host part of base_url

send_dimensions.description: provider openai: also send `dimensions: dim` (models that can shorten their vectors)

api_key_env.description: the name of the environment variable that holds the API key; the key is never stored

api_key_command.description: an external program (no shell) that prints the API key on standard output; the key is neither stored nor logged

retries.description: provider openai: how often a request is repeated after a timeout, a 429 or a 5xx answer (default 2); other errors are not retried

retry_backoff_ms.description: provider openai: the wait before the first retry, doubled each time (default 500); a Retry-After header of the service is honoured up to 30 s

vector_weight.description: how much the vector ranking counts against the keyword ranking in a hybrid search; default 0.5 for the lexical hashing provider, 1.0 for a plugged-in model

active_profile.description: the profile in force (`--profile NAME` on a command overrides it)

profiles.description: named embedding profiles; the vectors of the index are bound to the one profile in force when they are made, and never mixed with those of another

backend.description: where the derived index lives: sqlite (default; derived/index.db) or jsonl (derived/jsonl/, a plain-file reference store). Each backend has its own location and is rebuilt on its own.
